_comment: Per-network DNS and IPv6 settings for `tkoc firewall auto` and the
NetworkManager dispatcher installed by `tkoc firewall watch`.
Deliberately limited to DNS and IPv6. The dispatcher NEVER changes the
firewall tier, the nftables ruleset, or any service state: a policy that
loosened itself because you joined a particular Wi-Fi network would be a
policy an attacker can choose for you by naming an access point.
Match by SSID. `tkoc firewall learn` fills in the network you are on now.
